title: Why We Believe Rejection So Quickly (And What To Do Instead)

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换金钱之外还能赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”计划现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该计划，此后也支持了两届心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，且无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场团体大师班、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特南梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: How many times have you been told no and it's changed the direction of your life?
sentences.zh: 有多少次你被拒绝了，而这改变了你人生的方向？

sentences.en: A relationship breakup?
sentences.zh: 一段恋情的破裂？

sentences.en: A disappointing email?
sentences.zh: 一封令人失望的电子邮件？

sentences.en: Someone not offering you a job?
sentences.zh: 有人没有给你提供工作？

sentences.en: But what if the first answer isn't always the right answer?
sentences.zh: 但如果第一个答案并不总是正确的答案呢？

sentences.en: Today, I want to explore the psychology of hearing no.
sentences.zh: 今天，我想探讨听到拒绝背后的心理学。

sentences.en: Why we're so quick to believe it and why sometimes asking just one more question can change everything.
sentences.zh: 为什么我们这么快就相信它，以及为什么有时候多问一个问题就能改变一切。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Welcome to Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到“内在工作”。

sentences.en: I think that one of the reasons that it hurts so bad to be told no is if we really go back to our very early brain roots, being kind of a mammal community,
sentences.zh: 我认为，被拒绝之所以会带来如此剧烈的痛苦，原因之一在于如果我们追溯到非常原始的大脑根源，作为哺乳动物社群的一部分，

sentences.en: being accepted by others is very much key to our survival.
sentences.zh: 被其他人接纳对我们的生存至关重要。

sentences.en: So when we are shunned, when we're told no, when those boundaries are put in place, it can make us feel really vulnerable and very much a threat.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们被排挤、被拒绝、当那些界限被建立起来时，会让我们感到非常脆弱，并带来巨大的威胁感。

sentences.en: So I think it activates that kind of sense of danger.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为这激活了那种危险感。

sentences.en: I'm a youngest child, and I do think there's something a little bit linked to birth order here as well, because my youngest child, who's just turned 10, he will hear no.
sentences.zh: 我是家里最小的孩子，我觉得这其实也和出生顺序有点关系，因为我刚满10岁的小儿子，他听到“不”的时候，

sentences.en: He doesn't really take that as a final offer.
sentences.zh: 他并不真的把那当作最终决定。

sentences.en: If he's not happy with that, he will go on and on and on and on, wearing me down until eventually I'll go, right, OK, we'll do that thing.
sentences.zh: 如果他对结果不满意，他就会没完没了地说个不停，把我磨得精疲力竭，直到最后我说：好吧，好吧，我们就按那个做吧。

sentences.en: It isn't constant, and I am aware that it's that intermittent reinforcement that is the hardest thing to break.
sentences.zh: 这不是一成不变的，我也知道正是这种间歇性强化最难打破。

sentences.en: So I probably have made that rod for my own back.
sentences.zh: 所以我大概是作茧自缚了。

sentences.en: And what we're not talking about here is we're not talking about breaking people down,
sentences.zh: 我们在这里讨论的不是去击溃别人，

sentences.en: kind of if they said no to wanting to be intimately involved with you or kind of pursuing anything sexually.
sentences.zh: 也就是当他们拒绝与你有亲密接触或追求任何性行为时。

sentences.en: So please, obviously, no often does mean no.
sentences.zh: 所以请注意，显然“不”通常确实意味着“不”。

sentences.en: That's not what we're talking about here.
sentences.zh: 这并不是我们在这里讨论的内容。

sentences.en: Whilst I do try and teach people that no is a complete sentence, it rarely is just said so succinctly.
sentences.zh: 虽然我确实试图教导人们“不”是一个完整的句子，但它很少被说得如此简练。

sentences.en: And even when it is, our brain will often provide other reasons that may or may not be true.
sentences.zh: 甚至即使是这样，我们的大脑通常也会提供其他可能是真也可能不是真的理由。

sentences.en: You know, you're not good enough.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你不够优秀。

sentences.en: You're too old.
sentences.zh: 你太老了。

sentences.en: You're too young.
sentences.zh: 你太年轻了。

sentences.en: You know, you're too tall.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你太高了。

sentences.en: You're too short.
sentences.zh: 你太矮了。

sentences.en: You're too something else.
sentences.zh: 你别的什么地方不太行。

sentences.en: You know, you're never going to get there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你永远也到不了那个目标。

sentences.en: You can kind of very easily become your own worst inner critic.
sentences.zh: 你很容易就会成为自己最严厉的内在批判者。

sentences.en: So I know it's difficult when I get emails or news that is different than what I wanted.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道，当我收到与我预期不同的电子邮件或消息时，这很难受。

sentences.en: Because actually, when we want something, you know, we've done our best to ask for it, to have our needs met.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，当我们想要某样东西时，你知道的，我们已经尽最大努力去争取了，去满足我们的需求了。

sentences.en: And then someone goes, no, no, this is not for you.
sentences.zh: 然后有人说：不，不，这不适合你。

sentences.en: This is not your path for destiny.
sentences.zh: 这不是你命运的道路。

sentences.en: You're like, but I wanted that.
sentences.zh: 你会想：但我想要那个啊。

sentences.en: I really wanted that.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想要那个。

sentences.en: And, you know, but also it can just make us feel like, yeah, critical and hurt.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这也只会让我们感到，是的，被批判和受伤。

sentences.en: And I find that rather than reacting straight away, giving myself some time to let that percolate through, I am, I think, on balance, quite creative.
sentences.zh: 我发现与其马上作出反应，不如给自己一些时间让它慢慢沉淀，总的来说，我其实还挺有创造力的。

sentences.en: And sometimes just giving me a couple of days to have a think around something and to maybe come up with a different way, a different proposal,
sentences.zh: 有时只要给我几天时间去思考某件事情，并可能会想出另一种方式、另一个方案，

sentences.en: a different way of doing something that still meets my needs.
sentences.zh: 一种既能满足我的需求，又能实现目标的新方法。

sentences.en: But maybe helps others kind of see why this would be a really good idea.
sentences.zh: 但也许这能帮助其他人理解为什么这是一个好主意。

sentences.en: That can be really helpful in work situations.
sentences.zh: 这在工作场合中会非常有用。

sentences.en: Now, obviously, you don't want to be the one that, like my 10-year-old son, is going on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 当然，你可不想像我那个10岁的儿子那样没完没了地纠缠。

sentences.en: So it's about picking the balance, picking the battles that are right for you to fight for.
sentences.zh: 所以关键在于把握平衡，选择那些真正值得你去争取的事情。

sentences.en: And I think this episode really came up for me because of the conversation I had with Esther Teo about the BPS equivalence route, where she was initially told, no,
sentences.zh: 我想这一期节目之所以出现，是因为我与埃丝特·戴（Esther Teo）关于BPS同等学历认证途径的对话，她最初被告知，不，

sentences.en: you haven't met the criteria.
sentences.zh: 你没有达到标准。

sentences.en: But actually, when she dug a little deeper, she realised that the wrong email had been responded to.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，当她深入探究时，她意识到那是回复错了邮件。

sentences.en: They just hadn't really grasped what it was that she was asking.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没有真正理解她到底在问什么。

sentences.en: And it had been a case of basically computer says no, because the humans hadn't really seen for the meaning, because I think it is still quite uncommon as a route.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是“电脑说不”的情况，因为人类并没有真正看透其中的含义，因为我认为作为一条路径这依然相当少见。

sentences.en: So I think, yeah, just be really clear that what you are being turned down for is what you actually applied for.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，是的，一定要弄清楚你被拒绝的事项确实是你所申请的内容。

sentences.en: Or does it make sense or does some of the phraseology, you're like, hmm, I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 或者这合理吗，还是某些措辞让你觉得：嗯，我不太确定。

sentences.en: I think there was maybe a miscommunication here.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这里可能有什么沟通误解。

sentences.en: So it always makes sense to have a read of it.
sentences.zh: 所以读一读它总是明智的。

sentences.en: Maybe ask someone else to read an email or a text message to get some different insight, because they might be able to do that in a slightly less emotionally involved way.
sentences.zh: 也许请其他人阅读电子邮件或短信，以获得一些不同的见解，因为他们可能会以一种情感卷入度稍低的方式来看待问题。

sentences.en: Even if they care greatly about you, you are the main player in your life.
sentences.zh: 即使他们非常关心你，你才是你生活中的主角。

sentences.en: And so they might be less moved by the immediate distress of that and more able to see some of the nuance.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们可能较少受到那种即时痛苦的影响，而更能看到一些细微差别。

sentences.en: I know a number of people who were in relationships and then their partner decided that I'm not really sure this is going to work for us.
sentences.zh: 我认识一些人，他们原本在恋爱中，然后他们的伴侣决定说：“我不太确定这是否适合我们。”

sentences.en: And it was, of course, devastating for the other person.
sentences.zh: 这当然对另一个人来说是毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: But, you know, over time, they asked for, you know, the position to be reviewed.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，随着时间的推移，他们请求重新评估这个立场。

sentences.en: And they've been together, you know, very happily for many years.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在一起，你知道的，非常幸福地度过了很多年。

sentences.en: So relationship breakups aren't always, you know, terminal, isn't always the end of the line.
sentences.zh: 所以恋情破裂并不总是，你知道的，是绝症，并不总是意味着终点。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, I think sometimes we are we're so inbuilt to respect the word no, to be respectful of people in positions of power as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想有时我们天生就会尊重“不”这个词，并且也尊重处于权力地位的人。

sentences.en: Let's just give ourselves a little bit of permission to be curious about the no, to think about whether there's any boundary we could push or explore.
sentences.zh: 让我们给自己一点允许去对“不”保持好奇，思考是否有任何界限我们可以推动或探索。

sentences.en: I think if you do hit a hard stop, a hard no, it can be a really important time to reassess your values, your priorities,
sentences.zh: 我想如果你真的遇到了死胡同、坚决的拒绝，这可能是一个重新评估你的价值观、你的优先事项的重要时机，

sentences.en: to think about your goals and where it is that you want to go and how you might get there.
sentences.zh: 去思考你的目标、你想去哪里以及你将如何到达那里。

sentences.en: Some of the things I've been told no to in the past have shaped my life to lead me to the life I live now and the one that I enjoy and the one that I enjoy.
sentences.zh: 过去有些对我说“不”的事情塑造了我的生活，引领我走向我现在的生活，以及我所享受的这种生活。

sentences.en: If I'd been told yes earlier on in my career for different roles or even for a doctorate in clinical psychology applications, I wouldn't be here.
sentences.zh: 如果我在职业生涯的早期对不同的职位，甚至对临床心理学博士申请得到了肯定的答复，我就不会站在这里。

sentences.en: I likely wouldn't have my husband or my children.
sentences.zh: 我可能也不会拥有我的丈夫和我的孩子们。

sentences.en: I'm recording this on a really hot day and I wouldn't have my in-law's lovely, cool house to go sit in to give me a break from my own hot box of a house.
sentences.zh: 我在一个非常炎热的日子里录制这个，我也不会有我公公婆婆凉爽舒适的房子可以去坐坐，好让我从自己这个闷热的小房子里解脱出来。

sentences.en: So, yeah, what have you learned about yourself?
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你对自己有了什么了解？

sentences.en: How has your life been shaped by no's and have you ever been able to gently push back on those no's?
sentences.zh: 你的生活是如何被这些“不”塑造的？你是否曾设法温和地回绝过这些“不”？

sentences.en: I would love to know in the comments.
sentences.zh: 我很想在评论区知道答案。

sentences.en: I hope you've enjoyed this episode of Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 希望你喜欢这一期的“内在工作”。

sentences.en: I've tagged another one in the end screen that I think you'll really enjoy too.
sentences.zh: 我在片尾屏幕上标记了另一期，我想你也会非常喜欢的。

sentences.en: Thanks for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 感谢成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: The next episode of Inner Work is available wherever you get your podcasts and on YouTube from 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 下一期“内在工作”将于英国时间周三晚上8点起在各大播客平台和YouTube上播出。

sentences.en: Wednesday, UK time.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you again.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: See you soon.
